limitations: Observed holdout reused openly; validation-driven selection does not create fresh independent evidence
One seed and only 49 recordings; correlated windows, no statistical superiority or location/session independence established
Custom recording split, not official five-fold DCASE; raw official-class subset fields are diagnostics only
Native 32 kHz pretrained encoder versus 16 kHz scratch is a confounded encoder-family comparison
Shorter one-second input differs from PANNs pretraining clip duration and reduced validation performance
Modest AP/macro F1 improvement accompanied by lower micro F1 and several per-class regressions
Coffee machine and shopping cart each have one positive test second; four classes no positive test labels; extreme rare-event recognition remains unresolved
Five-second selected model uses future offline audio within the recording; no streaming/source-separation claim
Pretraining clip-level overlap has not been independently audited
MAESTRO noncommercial custom terms apply to dataset-dependent artifacts; no audio/cache/weights public
